subject: It seems they are
author: Executioner_UK
body:
starting to roll out the codes -

from the Bizarre forum: Latest news: I've just got off the phone with Activision. They're starting to website update process this morning their time (West Coast USA), and they expect the majority of the codes to be out by mid-afternoon.

Apologies it's not happening for another few hours, but the gears are definitely in motion.
 

Gotta give the yanks time to get their coffee and donuts before the UK gets its e-mails 😛

 

Edit: I mentioned in a previous post that "Skirmish Mode" was weapon free, i misread the option in game. There are weapons, just for a max of 10 players. "Powered Up" mode is for up to 20 players with weapons. However in the final game there WILL be a weapon free race-only mode. Just thought i'd clear that up before i started getting messages later "Hey Ex, wheres this fookin weapon free mode" lol  my bad 😇

subject: Did i say all that
author: Executioner_UK
body:
lol, i hate reading back my own quotes 😳 but yeah everything i said plus more. The thing is, this game has surprised me because i hated BC for killing off the PGR series and swore blind i wouldnt touch BLUR, but now ive played it im happy with what they have done, especially keeping the "Skirmish Mode" weapon free so that hardcore racers have somewhere to play without fear of losing 1st place to a 40ft lightning bolt 🥵

"Powered Up" mode which is where the weapons are at is a real blast ( literally ) some of the active power ups are bonkers and with 20 players racing with all manner of sh*t kicking off there hasnt been one hint of slowdown or lag...quite impressive. Theres a few graphic hiccups, such as the road disappearing briefly at the pre-race line up but its a beta at the end of the day so any glitches like that are easily overlooked. The game = 10/10 for fun factor without a doubt. 👍
